timing.slot_start_reference: first VER start bit on physical RS-485 A/B
timing.request_rx_reference: request CRC stop bit on physical bus
timing.tx_complete_reference: request/response CRC stop bit physically sent
timing.response_rx_reference: response CRC stop bit physically received

baud_commit_history.start: first accepted COMMIT request CRC stop bit

node_time_observation.request_boundary: all timers with age >= interval advance before request classification at the same observed timestamp
node_time_observation.state_only_merge: elapsed state-only transitions join the request transaction plan before publish
node_time_observation.external_effect_drain: one due external effect per advance; later due effects remain active for the next same-time advance
node_time_observation.effect_publication: Node Core post-state predicate is the only authority that distinguishes committed due platform effects from future or still-uncommitted effect metadata
node_time_observation.adapter_contract: request path repeats NodeEngine execute at one request timestamp only when the Core effect-publication predicate says the timer effect is due; future effect metadata is not applied early; SET_BAUD applies then retries, ENTER_SLEEP terminates runtime; periodic no-request path drains NodeEngine advance
node_time_observation.direct_execute_fallback: execute advances time first and returns the first due external effect without classifying the request

persistence.atomicity: single atomic record or detectable A/B commit; corrupt/torn is absent
persistence.failure_attribution: a visible request persistence failure requires that request own the failed durable operation; unrelated coalesced timer durability must not fabricate a request completion
persistence.master_sleep_lease: durable relative state/duration; raw monotonic wake deadline forbidden

schema_lifecycle.boot: compare application descriptor identity with durable signature

master_baud.recovery_owner: Master baud and persistence state machine
master_baud.recovery_probe_order: candidate-major; every eligible known node before next generated baud
master_baud.recovery_eligibility: known normal address and own network and no sleep lease; stale online flag ignored
master_baud.recovery_proof: contract-valid normal READ_ADDR or contract-valid Wire exception at candidate baud
master_baud.recovery_no_proof: remain unknown; report failed pass and restart first generated candidate
master_baud.recovery_success: runtime baud known before persistence request; complete only after persistence success
master_baud.recovery_persist_failure: rollback runtime known state and restart registry scan

master_sleep.owner: Master transaction and lease state machine
master_sleep.retry: same SEQ; does not move epoch or expected wake

recovery_verify.owner: Master work scheduler and lease timer engine
recovery_verify.initial_probe: arm generated base delay from the current boot monotonic time
recovery_verify.failure: retain lease without OFFLINE; update transient result/attempt; arm bounded backoff
recovery_verify.reboot: re-arm a full generated backoff from new boot monotonic time
recovery_verify.fairness: round-robin work classes prevent sleep verification from starving eligible normal work
